summary: First-finish smoke test for AI Merchant OS Lite (Turkish B2B SaaS). All critical backend endpoints and core frontend flows work as expected. Demo mode active, Turkish characters preserved end-to-end, and Product Editor + Export + Bulk actions functional.
passed: GET /api/health -> {status:ok, demo_mode:true}
GET /api/dashboard/stats returns totals, missing_desc(6), missing_price(2), edited(0), last_import_at, recent_activities
GET /api/products with pagination works (total=13 seeded)
GET /api/products/{id} returns full product
PATCH /api/products/{id} updates improved_name with Turkish chars (200)
POST /api/products/{id}/revert (200)
POST /api/products/{id}/improve kind=both produces cleaned Turkish title + structured description (no fake specs, mentions category)
POST /api/import/preview (CSV UTF-8 BOM with ÇĞŞİÖÜ) returns columns/sample/rows correctly
POST /api/import/commit inserts new SKU (inserted:1)
POST /api/import/commit rejects missing sku/name mapping with HTTP 400 'SKU ve Ürün Adı eşleştirmesi zorunludur'
GET /api/import/sample returns UTF-8 BOM CSV template with Turkish sample rows
POST /api/bulk/improve-products kind=title updated:2
POST /api/bulk/category updated:2 (200)
POST /api/bulk/price-percent +10 updated:2 and reflected in export (99.90 -> 109.89)
GET /api/export/all, POST /api/export/selected, GET /api/export/filtered all return UTF-8 BOM CSV with Turkish chars preserved
Frontend loads at REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL, no console errors
Sidebar nav: Genel Bakış, Ürünler, İçe Aktar, Toplu İşlemler, Dışa Aktar, Ayarlar all navigate
Dashboard KPI cards (Toplam Ürün=14, Eksik Açıklama=6, Eksik Fiyat=2, Düzenlenen Ürün=2) + Son İçe Aktarma + Son Aktiviteler visible
Demo Modu badge visible in header
Products page renders 14 edit buttons; ProductEditor modal opens; improve-title-btn + save-btn functional (Kaydedildi toast observed)
Import/Bulk/Export pages render with expected Turkish UI content
